description: This file defines the YarnSchedulerBackend class for Apache Spark, which manages the integration with YARN resource manager, including executor requests, resource registration, and communication with the ApplicationMaster.

classes.name: YarnSchedulerBackend
classes.description: Abstract class managing Spark's interaction with YARN, including executor requests, resource registration, and communication with the ApplicationMaster.

classes.name: YarnSchedulerEndpoint
classes.description: RpcEndpoint for communication between Spark and the ApplicationMaster, handling executor loss reasons, disconnections, and requests.

classes.name: YarnDriverEndpoint
classes.description: DriverEndpoint extension with additional logic for handling executor disconnections and communication with the ApplicationMaster.

methods.name: bindToYarn
methods.description: Associates the application ID and attempt ID with the backend.

methods.name: startBindings
methods.description: Ensures application ID is set before starting.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the backend and requests zero executors to prevent resource leaks.

methods.name: applicationAttemptId
methods.description: Returns the application attempt ID if available.

methods.name: applicationId
methods.description: Returns the application ID as a string.

methods.name: prepareRequestExecutors
methods.description: Prepares a request object for executor allocation, filtering out excluded nodes.

methods.name: doRequestTotalExecutors
methods.description: Sends a request to the ApplicationMaster to allocate executors.

methods.name: doKillExecutors
methods.description: Requests the ApplicationMaster to kill specified executors.

methods.name: sufficientResourcesRegistered
methods.description: Checks if the registered executors meet the minimum ratio.

methods.name: getShufflePushMergerLocations
methods.description: Calculates and retrieves locations for shuffle push mergers based on heuristics.

methods.name: addWebUIFilter
methods.description: Adds a filter to the Spark UI for monitoring or security.

methods.name: createDriverEndpoint
methods.description: Creates a new Yarn-specific driver endpoint.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets internal state after ApplicationMaster failure.

methods.name: createTokenManager
methods.description: Creates a Hadoop delegation token manager for security.
